name: smwmusic-rudra-no-hihou-creatures-from-the-silent-sea
title: Rudra no Hihou - Creatures from the Silent Sea
description:
From the recent Kaizo hack Invictus.

Original samples used. This is a calm and atmospheric piece well suited for a cave, overworld, water, or other similar level.

There are two main sections: The first with the melody line played through vibraphone samples and the second with a similar melody played with a woodwind sample backed by staccato strings.

I pared this down from 6 tracks to 8 as it did not work well with any of the instruments playing in sfx channels.
